title: Climate
description: Climate is a Minecraft plugin that adds a dynamic temperature and season system to your server
body:
# 🌦 Climate – Dynamic Temperature & Seasons System

**Climate** is a Minecraft plugin that adds a dynamic temperature and seasons system to your server, while remaining lightweight and compatible with multiple gameplay styles.

It is designed to work equally well in SMP, Creative, OneBlock, or semi-RP servers.

---

## 🔥 Features

### 🌡 Dynamic Temperature System

- Automatically calculated temperature  
- Individual temperature for each player  
- Display in ActionBar  
- Command to check the temperature  

---

### 🍂 Season System

- Server-side season management  
- Ability to change the season manually  
- Base ready for future seasonal effects  

---

## ⚙ Commands

Main command:

`/climate`


Available sub-commands:

`/climate temp`

`/climate temperature`

`/climate temp <player>`

`/climate season set <season>`

`/climate season next`

`/climate toggle`

`/climate reload`

`/climate debug`


---

## 🧠 Custom Messages

- Fully configurable `messages.yml` file  
- Color support  
- Protection against missing message errors  

---

## ⚠ Beta Version

This plugin is currently in **public beta**.

That means:

- Some features are still in development  
- Adjustments and improvements may be made  
- Feedback is highly appreciated  

---

## 💬 Feedback

If you find a bug or have an idea for improvement, feel free to share it.

The plugin is actively being developed, and your feedback helps shape its future.
